rationale: X02 fired because six rows have no interest_rate or basis_spread while classified as PRIVATE_CREDIT. The raw SOI source localizes those six missing-rate cases to table 19 non-credit instruments: common equity, trust interest, real estate property, and money market fund rows. Their rate fields are N/A or absent in source because they are not private-credit loan rows, so the data error is the classification/asset-class assignment rather than a missing rate extraction from loan terms.
